english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term before a noun when something shows the whole surrounding view.

examples.english: This panoramic photo is very clear, and you can see the whole surrounding view.
examples.traditional: 呢張全景相影得好清楚，四周嘅景色都睇得晒。
